August 2026.title: Confluence Webinar Series launches August 27
August 2026.description: CIROH's monthly R2O2R webinar series is relaunching as Confluence, the Operational Hydrology Advances Webinar Series, held the fourth Thursday of each month. The first session, August 27 at 2:00 PM CT, features Witek Krajewski (University of Iowa) and Jim Smith (Princeton) on improving the NEXRAD network for flood prediction. Free and open to all; one registration covers the full season!

September 2026.title: CIROH Annual Science Meeting
September 2026.description: This year’s gathering brings together an extraordinary community of researchers, practitioners, students, and partners committed to advancing water science in service of society. Together, we will continue to build a collaborative, open-science community that transforms research into real-world impact.
